allowNegativeStock.label: Allow negative stock
allowNegativeStock.hint: If enabled, delivery notes can reduce stock below zero.

autoConfirmBatches.label: Auto-confirm batches
autoConfirmBatches.hint: When selling an item with batches, the system assigns them automatically using FIFO if none are chosen manually.

watermarkDraft.label: DRAFT watermark on open documents
watermarkDraft.hint: Adds the DRAFT watermark to PDFs of documents in open status.

watermarkPaid.label: PAID watermark on collected invoices
watermarkPaid.hint: Adds the PAID watermark (in green) to PDFs of fully collected invoices.

confirmBeforeCancel.label: Confirm before cancelling
confirmBeforeCancel.hint: Asks the user for confirmation before cancelling a document from the interface.

quoteDirectInvoiceEnabled.label: Allow invoicing quotes directly
quoteDirectInvoiceEnabled.hint: Shows “Create Invoice” on quotes, to invoice them without going through an order. Disable it if your company always goes from quote to order and then to invoice.

enforceWarehouseZones.label: Enforce warehouse zones
enforceWarehouseZones.hint: Requires a zone (warehouseZone) on document lines.

trackingChatEnabled.label: Keiro chat on public tracking
trackingChatEnabled.hint: Adds an AI chat to the public tracking page (/track/:token) so the customer can ask about their shipment or report an incident — no login required, so only enable it if you want to expose that surface publicly.

logisticsOnly.label: Logistics-only mode
logisticsOnly.hint: Hides Sales, Purchasing, Accounting, HR and Analytics. Only Home, Inventory, Business partners and Logistics remain. Useful for customers who only subscribe to the delivery module.

hrShiftsEnabled.label: HR · Shifts and templates
hrShiftsEnabled.hint: Enables the shift templates module and cyclic rotation patterns.

hrPlanningEnabled.label: HR · Planning
hrPlanningEnabled.hint: Monthly roster of assigned shifts with a calendar view.

hrTimeclockEnabled.label: HR · Clock-in
hrTimeclockEnabled.hint: Lets employees clock in/out from the web or from shared kiosks.

hrIncidentsEnabled.label: HR · Incidents and substitutions
hrIncidentsEnabled.hint: Configurable incident types and an assisted substitution flow when they apply.

hrAdvancedEnabled.label: Advanced HR+ (performance, costs, reviews, commissions, tasks)
hrAdvancedEnabled.hint: Enables collective agreements, performance reviews, SMART goals, sales commissions, performance dashboard, labor cost, tasks and Gantt.
